info.description:
# 🚀 **High-Scoring OOF & Submission Files**
**Playground Series - Season 6 Episode 9: Predicting Electric Vehicle Purchases**
🔗 [Competition Link](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/playground-series-s6e9)

🔗 [Submission notebook Link](https://www.kaggle.com/code/najiama/s6e9-electric-vehicle-oof-cv-0-94618-lb-0-94633/notebook)

Welcome! This notebook does not train models from scratch. Instead, it loads my high-scoring Out-of-Fold (OOF) predictions and test submission files generated from my private blending strategy. 

My goal is to share these outputs with the community so you can use them as inputs for your own stacking models or ensembles! 

### ⚙️ **Cross-Validation Setup (No Data Leakage!)**
To ensure these OOF files align perfectly with your own pipelines and are safe for stacking, I standardized the cross-validation strategy across all models. 

While some of the original public notebooks used different CV settings, **I forked, modified, and reran their code** so that every single model in this blend strictly uses the exact same setup:
**`StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)`**

---

### 🙏 **Acknowledgments & Credits**

My blending strategy incorporates predictions, features, and insights from the following fantastic public notebooks. Please make sure to check them out and give them an upvote!

* **[Дворкин Евгений Владимирович S6E9 Single XGB CV: 0.94488](https://www.kaggle.com/code/evgendvorkin/s6e9-single-xgb-cv-0-94488)**
* **[Chris Deotte Fable 5.1 - XGB Starter]( https://www.kaggle.com/code/cdeotte/fable-5-1-xgb-starter)**
* **[cstdy S6E9 LightGBM](https://www.kaggle.com/code/kirill0212/s6e9-lightgbm)**
* **[Krizsó Gergely EV Quantum Forge S6E9 XGBoost](https://www.kaggle.com/code/lucifer19/ev-quantum-forge-s6e9-xgboost)**
* **[Mizushima Toshihiko S6E9 Leak-Free Target + Frequency Encoding | LGBM](https://www.kaggle.com/code/mizushimatoshihiko/s6e9-leak-free-target-frequency-encoding-lgbm)**
* **[My public Pure LGBM Model CV 0.94587 LB 0.94612](https://www.kaggle.com/code/najiama/pure-lgbm-model-cv-0-94587-lb-0-94612)** "Pure LGBM_V1_oof.csv" and "Pure LGBM_V1_test.csv"
* **[Sergey Qt2024 simple 21 feature lfbm 0.9456+](https://www.kaggle.com/code/sergeyqt2024/simple-21-feature-lfbm-0-9456)** "Sergey_LGBM_oof.csv" and "Sergey_LGBM_submission.csv"


* Various helpful ideas and discussions from the competition forums.





---

### 📄 **Usage & License**

You are completely free to use, reproduce, and include these OOF and submission CSV files in your own pipelines and ensembles. I only ask that you comply with standard Kaggle rules and kindly provide credit or a link back to this notebook if you use them in a public blend.

**If you find these predictions helpful for your pipeline or ensemble, please consider leaving an upvote! 👍 It really helps keep me motivated to share more datasets and baselines with the community.**
